name: 78380 · Robstown, TX
findings: ZIP 78380 (Robstown) has 33 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 10 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78380 (Robstown) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
36% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 78380 (Robstown) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 58% of the typical level).
